projection_basis: two-point: 13.3 s one-off + 0.1584 ms per row-fit over 6422460 row-fits

full_headline.relative_note: the margin is pre-registered in ABSOLUTE Spearman (0.02). On this rung the comparator is ~0.11, so 0.02 is a ~18%% relative gain; the relative figure is reported beside it and is NOT the bar.

full_null.bar_note: the MEDIAN, not a single draw: a correct pipeline centred on zero still produces individual seeds out to +/-0.13 here, because a near-initialisation conv net is close to a random functional of base composition and composition predicts this rung at |0.1169|. The seed-count bar (>= 8 of 10, p = 0.055 under the null) is the primary noise control.
full_null.power_caveat: UNDER-POWERED AT THE PRE-REGISTERED SEED COUNT, and recorded so no reader over-trusts this gate. The null's across-seed spread is driven by random INITIALISATION, not by sample size -- a random composition functional's correlation with expression does not shrink as N grows -- so with sd ~0.10 the sem of the median over 10 seeds is ~0.032, LARGER than the 0.02 bar it is compared against. Resolving 0.02 would need ~50 seeds. Read `learned_contribution` below, which is paired within a seed and therefore does not carry that variance.
